mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, nickname FROM app_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (login_id, password_hash, nickname) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname})
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code FROM watchlist WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at, stock_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company (stock_code, company_name, market_type) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{market}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_code = VALUES(stock_code)
INSERT INTO watchlist (user_id, stock_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{code}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_code = VALUES(stock_code)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM watchlist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_code = #{code}
